en: the request is larger than the {#n} bytes this referee reads
zh: 请求超过了裁判端可读取的 {#n} 字节

en: the file is larger than the {#n} bytes this game reads
zh: 文件超过了本游戏可读取的 {#n} 字节

en: the file is {#a} bytes; this game reads save files up to {#b} bytes
zh: 文件有 {#a} 字节；本游戏最多读取 {#b} 字节的存档文件

en: the file is {#a} bytes; this game reads saves up to {#b} bytes
zh: 文件有 {#a} 字节；本游戏最多读取 {#b} 字节的存档

en: the file is incomplete: it ends after {#n} bytes, inside its own preamble
zh: 文件不完整：在 {#n} 字节处就结束了，连文件头都不完整

en: the file uses save-file format {#a}; this build reads format {#b}. It was probably written by a newer version of the game
zh: 该文件使用存档格式 {#a}；当前版本读取的是格式 {#b}。它很可能由更新版本的游戏写入

en: the file uses save-file options ({flags}) this build does not know
zh: 该文件使用了当前版本不认识的存档选项（{flags}）

en: the file declares a {#a}-byte description; at most {#b} bytes are allowed
zh: 文件声明的说明信息有 {#a} 字节；最多允许 {#b} 字节

en: the file is incomplete: it ends after {#a} bytes, inside its {#b}-byte description
zh: 文件不完整：在 {#a} 字节处就结束了，{#b} 字节的说明信息没有写完

en: the file's description cannot be read: {why}
zh: 无法读取文件的说明信息：{why}

en: the file is packed with '{codec}', which this build does not read
zh: 该文件使用“{codec}”压缩，当前版本无法读取

en: the file is incomplete: it holds {#a} of {#b} bytes
zh: 文件不完整：应有 {#b} 字节，实际只有 {#a} 字节

en: the file is damaged: {#n} bytes follow the end of the save
zh: 文件已损坏：存档结尾之后还多出 {#n} 字节

en: this file was saved by rules {theirs}; this build runs rules {ours}
zh: 此文件由规则 {theirs} 保存；当前版本运行的是规则 {ours}

en: this file was saved by content {theirs}; this build runs content {ours}
zh: 此文件由内容 {theirs} 保存；当前版本运行的是内容 {ours}

en: this file was saved by session format {theirs}; this build runs session format {ours}
zh: 此文件由对局格式 {theirs} 保存；当前版本运行的是对局格式 {ours}

en: the save would unpack to {#a} bytes; this game accepts at most {#b} bytes
zh: 存档解压后将有 {#a} 字节；本游戏最多接受 {#b} 字节

en: the file is damaged: {#a} packed bytes cannot hold the {#b} bytes it declares
zh: 文件已损坏：{#a} 字节的压缩数据不可能容纳它声明的 {#b} 字节

en: the file is damaged or hostile: it unpacks to more than the {#n} bytes it declares
zh: 文件已损坏或带有恶意：解压后超过了它声明的 {#n} 字节

en: the file is damaged: it unpacks to {#a} bytes, not the {#b} it declares
zh: 文件已损坏：解压后是 {#a} 字节，而不是它声明的 {#b} 字节

en: the save text cannot be read: {why}
zh: 无法读取存档文本：{why}

en: the save cannot be played: {why}
zh: 该存档无法继续对局：{why}

en: a save named '{name}' already exists
zh: 已有名为“{name}”的存档

en: seat {#n} of this save is an LLM agent seat, which needs the server-backed game; this referee has no agent workers
zh: 此存档的第 {#n} 席是大模型智能体席位，需要服务器版游戏；本裁判端没有智能体工作进程
